optimizedDescription.value: Per-workspace SpecRepository port: get/list/artifact/save + metadata/persisted-state snapshots without storage coupling.

optimizedContext.value:
# SpecRepository Port

## Rules
- Extends `Repository`; immutable `workspace()`/`ownership()`/`isExternal()` from construction. One instance per workspace.
- `get(name)` → `Spec|null` (no content): workspace, name, `artifacts[]` ({filename,lastModified}), `persistedStateStamp`, `generatedMetadataStamp`; helpers `filenames`/`hasArtifact`. No hashes/fingerprint.
- `list(prefix?, options?)` → `ListResult<SpecListEntry>`; sort capability path asc; no default limit. Options: `includeSummary`, `includeMeta` (never hash on Meta).
- `SpecListEntry` required: workspace, path, title (metadata title → last path segment). Summary: optimizedDescription → description → extract from spec.md. `includeMeta` adds artifacts/persistedStateMeta/generatedMetadataMeta without hash. include* = projection only; no extra I/O. Per-entry resolve errors swallowed.
- `artifact`/`save` only schema-valid artifact filenames; `spec-lock.json` NOT via artifact API — use persisted-state ops. Path confinement to spec dir.
- `save`: `readOnly` → `ReadOnlyWorkspaceError` before I/O; else conflict via `originalHash` → `ArtifactConflictError` unless `force`.
- `delete` removes entire spec dir. `resolveFromPath` → `{specPath,specId}` | `{crossWorkspaceHint}` | null; relative needs `from`, pure.
- `readMetadataSnapshot` kinds: present|missing|invalid — NOT freshness. `writeMetadataSnapshot` full replace with `expectedRevision` (null=create). Replaces old metadata()/saveMetadata(). No generate/freshness here.
- Aggregate: `readPersistedState`/`writePersistedState` (atomic, expectedRevision); `persistedStateMeta`/`generatedMetadataMeta` (hash opt-in); `specFingerprint` = hash of sorted JSON {artifacts contentHashes, persistedStateHash or `__absent__`}; `artifactMeta`. No raw SpecLockData; no separate `persistedStateHash` method. `metadata.json` not fingerprint input.
- `search(query)` → SpecSearchResult[] (spec, score, matches{filename,line,snippet≤120}); score desc.
- Abstract class; abstract storage methods listed in full spec. `count()` = list.meta.total from index. `reindex()` rebuilds `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/specs/<workspace>/`. FS adapters expose absolute `specsPath`.

## Constraints
- Single workspace, immutable binding.
- get/list never load artifact content; search may.
- ArtifactConflictError sole concurrency error for save/writePersistedState/writeMetadataSnapshot.
- writeMetadataSnapshot NOT readOnly-guarded (cache vs canonical ownership distinct); save/writePersistedState ARE.
- Reads always allowed on readOnly.
- No direct sidecar access by app logic; no validate-cache helpers; no freshness classification on port.
- list includeMeta NEVER returns hashes.
